input:
CATEGORY: 病 is not a normal Adj. (Grammar)
definition: Do not treat verbs or nouns such as 病 / 生病 as ordinary adjectives with 很 or 不. Use patterns such as 病得很厉害 when describing the degree.

HER NOTES IN THIS CATEGORY (4 distinct):
2 | “病” is not a normal Adj., so it cannot be with 很 or 不
1 | 病得很厉害，“病” is not a normal Adj., so it cannot be with 很 or 不
1 | “生病” is not an Adj., so it cannot be with 很 or 不
1 | “生病”cannot be with “很”

HER CORRECTIONS (6 of 6):
[shennong_samples#34/f4/p0/note/e0] 他⟦病得很⟧  || her note: 病得很厉害，“病” is not a normal Adj., so it cannot be with 很 or 不
[shennong_samples#13/f4/p0/k0/e0] [然后，不病→就好了]  || her note: “病” is not a normal Adj., so it cannot be with 很 or 不
[shennong_samples#31/f2/p0/k0/e0] 他看到很多人[很病→生病]了  || her note: “病” is not a normal Adj., so it cannot be with 很 or 不
[shennong_samples#17/f0/p0/k0/e0] 神农看他的朋友[很生病→病得很重]  || her note: “生病” is not an Adj., so it cannot be with 很 or 不
[shennong_samples#6/f3/p0/k0/e0] 这朵花他一吃[就很生病→就病得很重]  || her note: “生病”cannot be with “很”
[mengmu_samples#2/f7/p0/k0/e0] 一天孟子[病了很重→病得很重]

output.rule: “病” and “生病” are not normal Adj., so do not use 很 or 不 directly with them. To show degree, use 病得很厉害 or 病得很重.
output.explanation_template: <wrong> → <correct>: 病/生病 is not a normal Adj., so it cannot take 很 or 不; use 病得很<degree> to describe how serious the illness is.

examples.explanation: 病得很 → 病得很厉害: 病 is not a normal Adj., so use 病得很厉害 to show the degree.
很生病 → 病得很重: 生病 is not an Adj., so it cannot take 很; use 病得很重.
不病 → 就好了: 病 is not a normal Adj., so it cannot take 不.
病了很重 → 病得很重: use 病得很重 to describe how serious the illness is.
